title: My Real Bitcoin Mining Stats: 114 TH GoMining Dashboard
hook: Here’s what my GoMining dashboard actually looks like.

scenes.narration: My miner is running at 114.45 terahash, with an average efficiency of 14.92 watts per terahash and an 18.72 percent discount.
Yesterday, I earned 4 dollars and 30 cents. This month so far, I’ve earned 77 dollars and 53 cents, with total lifetime earnings of 888 dollars and 99 cents.
Remember, these are my personal results. Rewards fluctuate with Bitcoin’s price and mining difficulty, so your earnings could be lower. This isn’t a promise of returns or financial advice.

cta: Curious about how digital Bitcoin mining works? Check out the link in my bio.
